title: Pastel 3D Totem
description: This resource pack replaces the standard texture of the Totem of Immortality with its 3D pastel version
body:
The resource pack replaces the standard Totem of Immortality with an enhanced 3D version. It's recommended to use Optifine, or mods that replace Optifine!
This resource pack may not be the final version and will be subject to change. I also recommend checking out my other projects!
